raw_corpus.sanskrit: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
topics: what does this verse say about karma
duty without attachment to results
why should we act without expecting rewards
raw_corpus.gloss: You have a right to perform your duty, but never to the fruit of that action; do not act for the sake of results, nor let attachment to inaction take hold of you.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः। अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
topics: is the soul immortal in the gita
what happens to the atman at death
eternal nature of the self
raw_corpus.gloss: The self is never born and never dies; it is unborn, eternal, permanent and ancient, and is not slain when the body is slain.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः। आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत॥
topics: how to deal with pleasure and pain
why are sensations temporary
advice on enduring hardship
raw_corpus.gloss: Contact between the senses and their objects gives rise to heat and cold, pleasure and pain; these are fleeting and impermanent, so one should learn to tolerate them.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः। स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते॥
topics: influence of leaders on society
why does example matter more than words
role model behaviour in the gita
raw_corpus.gloss: Whatever a great person does, others follow; whatever standard they set, the world follows it.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
raw_corpus.iast: yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati bharata
topics: why does krishna say he incarnates
decline of dharma and divine intervention
purpose of avatars in the gita
raw_corpus.gloss: Whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness rises, I manifest myself, age after age.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
topics: self reliance in the gita
who is your own best friend or enemy
lifting yourself up by your own effort
raw_corpus.gloss: One should lift oneself by one's own effort and not degrade oneself; the self alone is the friend of the self, and the self alone is its enemy.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः। न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन॥
topics: balanced lifestyle for yoga practice
eating and sleeping habits for meditation
moderation advice in the gita
raw_corpus.gloss: Yoga is not for one who eats too much or too little, nor for one who sleeps too much or stays awake too much; balance in habits is essential.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते। सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
topics: how does anger arise according to the gita
chain reaction from attachment to anger
psychology of desire and anger
raw_corpus.gloss: Dwelling on sense objects creates attachment; attachment breeds desire; and desire, when frustrated, gives rise to anger.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया। विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
raw_corpus.iast: iti te jnanam akhyatam guhyad guhyataram maya
topics: does the gita ask for blind obedience
freedom of choice at the end of the gita
krishna's final instruction to arjuna
raw_corpus.gloss: Thus this knowledge, more secret than all secrets, has been declared to you; reflect on it fully and then act as you choose.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते। तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्॥
topics: divine protection for devotees
what does krishna promise to sincere devotees
meaning of yoga-kshema
raw_corpus.gloss: For those who worship with single-minded devotion, thinking of nothing else, I personally provide for what they lack and preserve what they have.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी॥
raw_corpus.iast: advesta sarva-bhutanam maitrah karuna eva ca
topics: qualities of an ideal devotee
what makes someone dear to god in the gita
description of a compassionate person
raw_corpus.gloss: One who bears no ill will toward any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, equal in pleasure and pain, and forgiving — such a person is dear.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते॥
topics: definition of yoga in the gita
what does equanimity mean
acting with balance of mind
raw_corpus.gloss: Perform your actions established in yoga, abandoning attachment, and remain even-minded in success and failure; this evenness of mind is called yoga.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः॥
topics: why follow your own path in life
imperfect duty versus another's duty
svadharma explained
raw_corpus.gloss: It is better to imperfectly follow one's own path than to perfectly follow another's; better to die pursuing one's own duty, for another's path is fraught with danger.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः। स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्॥
topics: paradox of action and inaction
who is truly wise according to the gita
seeing inaction in action
raw_corpus.gloss: One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise among people; such a person, though engaged in all activities, remains a true practitioner of yoga.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्। अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
topics: how to control a restless mind
practice and detachment for mental discipline
taming the mind in the gita
raw_corpus.gloss: The mind is indeed restless and hard to control, but it can be mastered through steady practice and detachment.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
topics: three gates to self destruction in the gita
lust anger and greed
what should a person renounce
raw_corpus.gloss: Lust, anger and greed are the three gateways to self-destruction; a person should abandon all three.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः। मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति॥
topics: relationship between the soul and the divine
what is the eternal fragment in living beings
mind and senses drawn from nature
raw_corpus.gloss: The individual soul in this world is an eternal fragment of the divine self, and it draws to itself the mind and the five senses situated in material nature.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे। गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः॥
topics: why do the wise not grieve
opening teaching of the gita on grief
krishna's first response to arjuna's sorrow
raw_corpus.gloss: You grieve for those who should not be grieved for, yet you speak words of wisdom; the truly wise do not mourn for the living or the dead.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः। तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर॥
topics: work as sacrifice in the gita
how to act without being bound by action
meaning of yajna as duty
raw_corpus.gloss: Work done as an offering frees a person from bondage; all other work binds one to this world, so one should act without attachment, treating action as an offering.

raw_corpus.sanskrit: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्। आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः॥
topics: list of virtues in the gita
qualities that constitute true knowledge
humility nonviolence and self-control
raw_corpus.gloss: Humility, freedom from pretension, non-violence, patience, honesty, service to a teacher, purity, steadfastness and self-control are described as constituting true knowledge.
